title: [GMCP 203.047.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Documentation, examples, developer experience, release quality, and SLOs
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-047-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Versioned operator, author, host, security, migration, troubleshooting and architecture documentation is executable and matches shipped behavior; examples cover every primitive and official extension from minimal to production. One-command setup and diagnostics pass usability studies, releases carry compatibility/SBOM/provenance evidence, and published availability, recovery, performance and support SLOs are measured with error-budget policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
